name: Retrieval practice in prose
description: An unstructured study journal explains mechanisms rather than naming them in headings or a glossary.

blocks.text: Retrieval practice makes you reconstruct an answer without looking. Spaced repetition schedules those attempts further apart as recall gets stronger.
Interleaving mixes problem types. Unlike blocked practice, interleaving forces you to decide which method fits before applying it.
Desirable difficulty: the attempt can feel harder now while improving retention later. Retrieval practice is one example of desirable difficulty.
